CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION compute_rrs()
RETURNS TABLE(reckey bigint, rrs numeric) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT DISTINCT r.reckey, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.recscore + r.confval + s.recutil) / 3.0 AS numeric), 4)
    FROM recommendations r
    JOIN interactions i ON r.reckey = i.reclink
    JOIN sessions s ON i.seshlink2 = s.seshkey
    GROUP BY r.reckey, r.recscore;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
